text.en: Precision hits return ammo to the mag. Landing 4 precision hits loads a delayed Solar explosive round for your next shot.

Precision Hits <title refill [G_refill] /> 1 ammo.

Scoring 4 Precision Hits loads a delayed Solar Explosive. Solar Explosive is removed after 6 seconds.

Solar Explosive detonates after a 0.5? second delay, dealing <pve 198 /> <pvp [78] /> damage and applying <solar/>40 Scorch stacks (60 with <solar/>Ember of Ashes) in a 2 meter radius.

Precision Hits <title refill [G_refill] /> 1 ammo.

Scoring 4 Precision Hits loads a delayed Solar Explosive. Solar Explosive is removed after 6 seconds.

Solar Explosive detonates after a 0.5? second delay, dealing <pve 215 /> <pvp [78] /> damage and applying <solar/>40 Scorch stacks (60 with <solar/>Ember of Ashes) in a 4 meter radius. Damage falls to 0% at the edge of the radius.
